notes: Judge questions per canonical case and workflow. Each dimension has one verdict with a one-sentence reason. The judge reads only the run bundle. Judge results are advisory until calibrated against human spot-checks and never override a code check.

questions.question: Does the reply accurately describe the recorded engagement that was created, including its name and description?
Does the reply avoid disclosing engagement details absent from the recorded creation result?
Is the creation confirmation clear and useful to the requester?
Does the reply accurately describe the recorded status and status note change?
Does the reply avoid disclosing engagement details absent from the recorded authorized change result?
Is the change confirmation clear and useful to the requester?
Does the reply accurately convey the recorded contents of the Acme Internal AI Chatbot engagement?
Does the reply avoid disclosing details that are absent from the recorded authorized result?
Is the reply clear and useful for a meeting-preparation request?
Is every engagement and status named in the reply supported by the recorded list and get results?
Does the reply avoid disclosing engagement details absent from the authorized recorded results?
Is the reply clear and appropriately concise for a portfolio-triage request?
Does the reply accurately describe both the recorded status change and the recorded personal task that was created?
Does the reply avoid disclosing engagement or personal task details absent from the recorded results?
Is the wrap-up confirmation clear and useful to the requester?
Does the reply accurately describe the recorded outcome without asserting an unsupported access explanation?
Does the reply avoid confirming whether the requested engagement exists?
Is the response clear and appropriately neutral for an unavailable request?
Does the conversation accurately describe the recorded meeting brief, status update, navigation, and captured personal task outcomes?
Does the conversation avoid disclosing facts absent from the recorded authorized results?
Is the conversation clear and useful across the full meeting-preparation-to-action workflow?
